opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, co (restaurant), notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and read population
Search the city on timeanddate and open weather page for temperature
On Booking enter city, dates, travelers and search; open a hotel and view price
On Viator search for two activities in the city and open each result
On the restaurant site enter city and cuisine, pick date, search, open a restaurant
Create a new note summarizing city, dates, population, temperature, hotel, activities, dinner
Compose email to the friend with subject and body summarizing the plan, then discard/finish
